וְחַיּוֹת אֲשֶׁר הֵנָּה מְרֻבָּעוֹת כִּסֵּא. בְּמָאתַיִם וַחֲמִשִּׁים וָשֵׁשׁ מַכְנִיפוֹת כִּסֵּא. גּוֹעֲשׁוֹת בּוֹ בְּסוֹכְכָם פָּנִים כְּפָנִים לַכִּסֵּא. דְּמוּת רָקִיעַ בְּרָאשָׁם נָטוּי לַכִּסֵּא. הוּא כְּעֵין הַקֶּרַח בּוֹ שְׁבִיב כִּסֵּא. וּמִמַּעַל לָרָקִיעַ כְּמַרְאֵה דְּמוּת כִּסֵּא. זָעוֹת בְּלִי לֵאוֹת מֵחִיל כִּסֵּא.

blocks.text: ק׳ כַּף רֶגֶל חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וַחֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה יְשָׁרָה לַכִּסֵּא. לְעֵת תֵרָשֶׁינה לְפָאֵר קוֹפְצוֹת מִתַּחַת לַכִּסֵּא. מִתְעַלְּפוֹת מִפַּחַד רָם יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא. נִרְאוֹת נוֹשְׂאוֹת וְהֵם נְשׂוּאוֹת עִם כִּסֵּא. סְבוּלוֹת מִתַּחַת זְרוֹעוֹת עוֹלָם לַכִּסֵּא. עֲתִירַת זוֹ כְּתַעַל תְּרַפֶּינָה כְּנַף כִּסֵּא. פְּשָׁעִים אִם עָצְמוּ מַשִּׁיקוֹת כִּסֵּא. צוֹרֵר כִּי יַסְטִין יְפַרְשֵׁז עֲנַן כִּסֵּא. קוֹל שׁוֹפָר לְעֵת יַעַל מְאַחֵז פְּנֵי כִסֵּא. רַחֲמִים יָלִיץ בְּעַד רְשׁוּמִים בַּכִּסֵּא. שׁוֹפֵט אִם יִרְצֶה שֶׁבֶת בְּאוּלָם הַכִּסֵּא. תַּבְנִית תָּם יֶפֶן חֲקוּקָה בַּכִּסֵּא. אַרְבַּע חַיּוֹת נוֹשְׂאוֹת וּמְנֻשָּׂאוֹת עִם כִּסֵּא:

blocks.text: According to the mystic utterance of the holy Seraphim, who sanctify Thy Name in holiness, those who dwell above and those who dwell below, proclaim three times the threefold sanctification in sanctity, as it is written through Thy prophet, once calls to the other and says:
‘Holy, Holy, Holy is the Lord of Hosts, the whole earth is full of His glory’.
His glory fills the world, His servants ask one of the other: ‘Where is the site of His glory?’ Those opposite them say: ‘Blessed . . .’.

Have mercy on the pillars (the pious) upon which Thou hast founded the footstool (the earth) and the throne; then the Galgal thunders and the throne resounds from Ophan to Ophan, from Hayah to Hayah, from Cherub to Cherub opposite the throne.
His glory fills the world, His servants ask one of the other: ‘Where is the site of His glory?’ Those opposite them say: ‘Blessed . . .’.
Blessed be the glory of the Lord from His dwelling place.
From His dwelling place may He turn in mercy and show compassion to the people that proclaim the unity of His Name. Evening and morning twice each day do they constantly utter the Shema in love.

Thy people trust in repentance, whereby to unite completely both impulses of their heart before Thee. Grant it purity of hands that they may lift up the heart in unison; let the voice of the bent Shofar bend every heart, let the sign of the long drawn out Shofar (on fast days) point to an uncrumpled heart. From the destiny of days that were created,
